data.name: Ujjayant
data.gender_notes: Ujjayant is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Ujjayant means 'conquering' or 'victorious' in Sanskrit. It is derived from the root words 'ud' (up, superior) and 'jay' (victory). The name Ujjayant carries the meaning “Victorious” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Ujjayant usually hope their child will grow to embody victorious and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes triumph over adversity, and the inner power to conquer challenges.
data.etymology: Ujjayant belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Victorious.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ujjayant total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

historical_references.reference: Ujjain was the ancient capital of the Avanti Mahajanapada, located in present-day Madhya Pradesh, India. The city was known as Ujjayini during the Buddhist era and Ujjayant during the medieval period.
historical_references.time_period: 6th century BCE - 483 BCE (Buddhist era) and 550 CE - 1350 CE (medieval period)
historical_references.context: Ujjain was an important political and cultural center in ancient India.

historical_references.reference: Ujjain is mentioned in various Hindu scriptures, including the Mahabharata and the Puranas, as a sacred city and a center of learning. The city was ruled by several famous Hindu kings, including King Chandragupta Maurya and King Vikramaditya.
historical_references.time_period: 322 BCE - 298 BCE (reign of Chandragupta Maurya) and 600 CE - 1100 CE (rule of Vikramaditya)
historical_references.context: Ujjain was a major religious and educational hub in Hinduism.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Ujjayant is derived from the Sanskrit language and means 'unconquered'. In modern contexts, this name is often associated with practices and belief systems that promote inner peace, mental clarity, and spiritual growth. Ujjayant is seen on various platforms, including Yoga and Ayurveda, as a symbol of the unconquered self and the pursuit of self-realization. With the increasing popularity of meditation, spirituality, and mindfulness practices, Ujjayant has also gained significance in the technology industry, where it is used in the names of meditation apps and wellness technologies. For example, 'Ujjayant Meditation App' or 'Ujjayant Wellness Tech'.
